description: Model upgrade banner: Switch sends the newer model. The server offers an upgrade from the predictable model (display name "predictable") to a newer "Predictable Next" (ID predictable-next). Call "settings model" returns the "model" field of the first conversation settings POST (POST /api/conversation/<id>/settings) the page sent, or "none". "The banner" is the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-banner". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The banner's text should contain "Newer version of Predictable available". 3. The banner's text should contain "predictable → Predictable Next". 4. Call "settings model": it must return exactly "none". 5. Click the element with data-testid "model-upgrade-action". 6. Call "settings model" until it returns exactly "predictable-next".
